bc.title: Scan barcode
bc.help_camera: Hold the barcode on the back of the case inside the frame. Reads EAN-13, EAN-8 and UPC-A.
bc.help_type: Type the digits under the barcode and press Enter. A USB or Bluetooth barcode scanner works too: click in the field and scan.
bc.own_other_edition: You own a different edition of this game.
bc.added_own: Added to your collection as copy {n}
bc.undo_gone: Can't undo: another copy was added after this one. Remove it in the edit drawer.
bc.already_own_other: You already own a different edition of this game.
bc.already_wish: This game is already on your wishlist.
bc.several_hint: Pick the one you are holding.
bc.new_text: Nobody has linked this barcode to a game yet. Link it once and it is found for everyone on this site.
bc.only_admins: Only admins can link barcodes. It has been added to the list for them.
bc.game_hidden: This game is hidden from the catalogue by an admin, so it can't be opened or added.
bc.system_shown: The system is shown in your collection again.
bc.reported: Reported to the admins for removal.
bc.search_ph: Search a title in every system...
bc.one_edition: Only one edition of this game exists
bc.variant_help: When you scan this code later to add a copy, the variant is filled in for you.
bc.saved_for_all: Saved for everyone on this site. An admin can edit or remove it later.
bc.conflict: This barcode is already linked to {title} on {system}. Link it here as well?
bc.err_check: The last digit does not match: it should be {expected}. Re-scan or fix the digit.
bc.err_invalid: That is not a valid barcode. Check the digits or scan again.
bc.err_server: The server could not do this: {error}
bc.err_http: The server answered with an error (HTTP {status}).
bc.err_network: The server could not be reached: {error}
bc.err_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
bc.err_already_linked: That game already has this barcode.
bc.err_permission: The camera was not allowed. Allow camera access for this site in your browser, or type the digits.
bc.err_no_camera: No camera was found on this device.
bc.err_insecure: The camera only works on a secure (https://) page. Typing the digits and a USB scanner still work.
bc.err_in_use: The camera is in use by another app. Close it and try again.
bc.err_blocked_policy: The server blocks the camera (Permissions-Policy). An admin can fix this; see Settings › Barcodes › Camera check.
bc.err_camera: The camera could not be started.
bc.err_no_reader: This browser has no barcode reader and the bundled reader is missing. Type the digits instead.
bc.remove_confirm: Remove this barcode? This removes it for everyone.
bc.remove_confirm_eds: Remove this barcode from {labels}? This removes it for everyone.
bc.already_here: This game already has this barcode.
bc.upca_note: UPC-A codes (12 digits) are stored as EAN-13 with a leading 0, so both read the same. Only admins can remove a barcode; report it if it is wrong.
bc.upca_note_admin: UPC-A codes (12 digits) are stored as EAN-13 with a leading 0, so both read the same. Removing a barcode here removes it for everyone.
bc.admin_intro: Barcodes are shared by everyone on this site. They are added while scanning, imported from a CSV file or added here.
bc.help_all: Every barcode linked to a game, newest first.
bc.help_flagged: Users reported these barcodes as wrong. Remove them, or keep them to clear the report.
bc.help_unknown: Valid barcodes that were scanned but are not linked to a game yet.
bc.help_shared: Barcodes linked to more than one game. Normal for editions that share a case; on different systems it is probably a mistake.
bc.help_missing: Active games that have no barcode yet.
bc.empty_all: No barcodes yet. Scan your games and link them, or import a CSV file.
bc.empty_shared: No barcode is linked to more than one game.
bc.empty_missing: Every active game has a barcode.
bc.who_hint_all: Everyone can link barcodes to games while scanning. Users can report a wrong barcode; only admins remove barcodes.
bc.who_hint_admins: Only admins link barcodes. Unknown scans of other users wait in the Unknown scans list.
bc.add_page_link: Adding barcodes to many games? Use Add barcodes
bc.add_not_allowed: Only admins can add barcodes on this site.
bc.add_intro: Pick a system, click a game and keep scanning: every code goes to that game. Use ↑ / ↓ in the barcode field to move to the previous or next game.
bc.add_pick_first: Click a game in the list first.
bc.add_same: Read again: already on {title}. Nothing changed.
bc.add_sound_help: A beep for every read: high = added, two short = already there, low = not read correctly
bc.add_popup_blocked: The browser blocked the lookup window: allow pop-ups for this site.
bc.add_no_price_link: This game has no price link yet, so nothing was opened.
bc.undo_too_old: Only codes you added in the last 12 hours can be taken back here. Report it instead; an admin can remove it.
bc.enabled_help: Off: the Scan page, the Scan link in the header, looking up barcodes from the search box, the Barcodes section in the edit drawer and the Barcodes column are gone for everyone. Linked barcodes are kept, and this page stays available to admins.
bc.off_notice: Barcode scanning is switched off on this site.
bc.off_admin_notice: Barcode scanning is switched off: users don't see the scanner, the Scan link or barcodes in the edit drawer.
bc.off_admin_link: Switch it on in Settings › Barcodes
bc.cam_policy_fix: The Permissions-Policy header says camera=(). Change it to camera=(self) in web.config (IIS) or .htaccess (Apache), or the same header in your nginx configuration.
bc.cam_foot: Typing a barcode and using a USB scanner work without any of this.
bc.no_tables: The barcode tables don't exist yet. Run the database update in Settings › Updates.
bc.import_help: A header row is needed. Columns: barcode, and game_id or system (short name) + title (+ edition), plus optional variant and note. Comma or semicolon. A title that matches several games without an edition is listed as a problem, never guessed. An exported file can be imported again.
bc.import_sum_check: Check: {added} to add, {skipped} already there, {problems} problems. Nothing has been saved yet.
bc.import_err_empty: Paste a CSV file or choose one.
bc.import_err_header: The first line must name the columns: barcode, and game_id or system and title.
bc.import_err_lines: The file has more than {n} lines. Split it into smaller files.
bc.import_p_ambiguous: Several games have this title: add the edition column
dashboard.subtitle: Overall collection overview — {user}
dashboard.click_to_show: Click to make this system visible
dashboard.confirm_show: Make this system visible in your collection?
import.title: Import Game List
import.intro:
Paste a list of game titles — one per line — select the system and click Preview.
Duplicate titles already in the database will be flagged and skipped automatically.
import.placeholder: Paste one game title per line, e.g.:
import.err_no_titles: Please paste some game titles first.
import.summary_dupe_one: {n} already exists and will be skipped
import.summary_dupe_other: {n} already exist and will be skipped
import.done_one: Import complete — {n} game added, {skipped} skipped (already existed).
import.done_other: Import complete — {n} games added, {skipped} skipped (already existed).
common.currency_note: Prices are stored exactly as imported ({symbol}) and never converted: convert the CSV to your currency before you import it.
prices.intro:
Paste your price CSV export. Matching priority: 1) by external_id  2) by console + title  3) import as new game.
CIB price, link and cover art are updated if they differ from what's stored. Existing cover art is never overwritten.
prices.paste_csv: Paste CSV or choose a file
prices.example_note: The columns the import reads, filled with a few games from your own catalogue. The console column uses your systems’ short names; importing the example unchanged changes nothing.
prices.opt_update_only: Only update games that are already in the catalogue (don't add new ones)
prices.opt_new_hidden: Add new games as hidden (inactive) — switch them on later in the catalogue
prices.res_not_added_one: {n} game not in the catalogue skipped (update only)
prices.res_not_added_other: {n} games not in the catalogue skipped (update only)
common.col.title: Title
common.cols.title: Columns
common.cols.help: Switch columns on or off and drag them (or use ↑ ↓) into the order you want. Saved automatically.
grading.mode_simple_desc: One label per copy, picked from a list. Quick, and what you used so far.
grading.mode_points_desc: Grade each part (box, manual, cartridge…) out of 100 by logging defects. The score maps to a label.
grading.mode_both_desc: Use either per copy. Pick a default below and switch any copy in its edit drawer.
settings.username_note: To change your username, ask the admin.
settings.language_desc: The language of the whole site for you. Your own data (system names, labels, options) stays as you typed it.
settings.theme_desc: Changes colours, fonts and effects on every page. Only you see your choice; your public wishlist is shown in it too. The theme marked ★ Site default is the one the admin picked for everyone.
settings.grading_desc: Choose which grading methods you use. You can switch at any time — nothing is lost: point scores and simple labels are both kept on every copy.
settings.switch_note: Switch any copy between Simple and Points in its edit drawer.
settings.grading_admin_note: Managed by the admin: the grade labels (and the score each one starts at), format profiles and component templates. Both methods use the same labels, so stats and filters stay consistent.
settings.sharing_desc: Make your wishlist publicly viewable — anyone with the link can view it without logging in.
settings.confirm_new_link: Generate a new link? The old link will stop working.
settings.tags_desc: Assign tags to games (e.g. “Must Have”, “Probably”, “Maybe”). Filterable in Collection and Wishlist.
settings.sites_desc: Add sites to get quick search links from the game sidebar. Use {system}, {title} and {region} as placeholders.
settings.wish_cols_desc: Choose which columns to show in the Wishlist page.
settings.coll_cols_desc: Choose which columns to show and drag to reorder.
settings.comp_desc: Drag to reorder, ✕ to remove. These appear in the completeness dropdown.
settings.played_desc: Drag to reorder, ✕ to remove. These appear in the played status dropdown.
settings.systems_desc: Toggle systems on/off, drag to reorder. Count totals controls whether a system is included in the global owned %, copies, and upgrade counts on the dashboard and collection page. Disable it for systems like “Hardware” that you don't want affecting your game completion stats. Spent and owned value always include all systems.
settings.backup_desc: Export your collection data (entries, prices, notes, condition grades, options) as a JSON file. Photos are not included — use Image Backups below. Import restores the data; older exports that still contain photos restore those too.
settings.import_warn: Import will merge data. Existing entries may be overwritten.
settings.import_confirm: Import will merge data. Existing entries may be overwritten. Continue?
settings.img_backups_desc: Generate a zip of your uploaded photos per system, organised as System/Game/photo.jpg. Download links are valid for 24 hours. One zip per system — generating a new one replaces the previous. Default cover art and system icons are not included.
settings.generating_zip: Generating zip for {name}… this can take a minute
settings.err_migration: Database update needed: an admin can run it in Settings › Updates.
coll.price_up: Up from {price} at the last price import ({date})
coll.price_down: Down from {price} at the last price import ({date})
drawer.upgrade_ph: e.g. cracked case, want sealed copy...
drawer.add_photos: Click or drag to add photos
drawer.save_first: Save the entry first before adding photos.
wish.not_public: This wishlist is not public or does not exist.
wish.empty_hint: Mark games as wishlisted from the collection page using the ♥ button.
admin.msg_pw_reset: Password reset. The user has been signed out everywhere.
admin.msg_unlocked_all: All lockouts and failure counters cleared.
admin.site.title: Site Settings
admin.site.desc: Apply to the whole site. Users can still pick their own language and theme in Settings.
admin.site.name: Name
admin.site.region_note: The region is the default for new systems and for the {region} placeholder in search links; each system keeps its own region (see Catalogue). The grading method only applies to users who register from now on.
admin.site.err_name: The site name must be 1–60 characters.
admin.site.err_symbol: The currency symbol must be 1–5 characters.
admin.site.err_seps: The decimal and thousands separators must be different.
admin.lang.title: Languages
admin.lang.desc: Every .json file in the lang/ folder is a language. English is the base: texts missing from another language are shown in English. Download a file to translate it, then upload it again.
admin.lang.default_note: Used on the sign-in page, on public wishlists and by users who haven't picked their own language.
admin.lang.not_writable: The lang/ folder is not writable by the web server, so uploads can't be saved. Give the web server (IIS: IUSR / the app pool identity) write access to it.
admin.lang.upload_note: The file needs "_meta": {"name": "…", "code": "xx"} (code like nl or pt-BR). Uploading a code that already exists replaces that language. Allowed markup in texts: <b> <i> <em> <strong> <code> <br>.
admin.lang.err_size: The file is too large (max 1 MB).
admin.lang.err_json: The file is not valid JSON (an object with texts).
admin.lang.err_code: _meta.code is missing or invalid (use e.g. nl or pt-BR).
admin.lang.err_html: Text “{key}” contains HTML that isn't allowed.
admin.theme.title: Site Default Theme
admin.theme.desc: Click a theme to make it the default for the whole site: the sign-in page and every user who hasn't picked their own theme in Settings. Users who did pick one keep theirs. To add a theme, drop a .css file into assets/themes/: it appears here automatically.
admin.theme.migrate: Run the database update under Settings › Updates so users can pick their own theme.
admin.img.title: Image Settings
admin.img.desc: Uploaded photos are automatically resized and compressed. EXIF orientation is corrected automatically on upload.
admin.ga.profiles_desc: Which parts a copy can have (box, manual, cartridge…) and how much each one weighs in the score. Each system gets a default profile; users can pick another one per copy.
admin.ga.templates_desc: How a part is graded: categories whose max points add up to 100, and the defects that deduct from them. One template can be shared by many parts (e.g. “Paper insert” for maps, inserts and cover art). Changing a deduction never rewrites logged defects; scores are recalculated when you save.
admin.inv.title: Invite Codes
admin.prices.desc: Paste your price CSV export to update CIB prices, links and cover art. Match priority: 1) by external_id  2) by console + title  3) import as new game.
admin.users.title: Users
admin.lock.title: Login Lockouts
admin.lock.desc: Failed sign-in counters per username (u:), IP address (ip:) and password-change attempts (pw: + user id). Unlocking also resets the counter.
admin.sys.name: Name
admin.sys.icons_desc: Each system can have two icons: one for dark themes and one for light themes. Pages show the one that fits the theme in use; with only one icon, it is used for both.
admin.games.title: Game Lists
admin.games.price_note: Leave a field empty to clear it. With a price source ID, the price import keeps the link and prices up to date.
admin.games.err_title: Enter a title for the game.
admin.games.err_external_id: The price source ID may only contain letters, numbers and dashes (max. 20).
admin.games.err_external_dupe: Price source ID {id} is already used by {title} ({system}).
admin.games.err_link: The price link must start with http:// or https:// (max. 255 characters).
admin.games.err_price: Prices must be a number, like 12.50.
grading.name: Name
grading.suggest_loose: loose|cart only|disc / cart only|disc only|game only
grading.suggest_msg: Completeness set to “{value}” from what's included — change it if needed.
grading.note_was_points: This copy was graded with points: {score} · {badge}. Picking a label here switches it to a simple grade — the point score is kept.
grading.note_kept: This copy's point score ({score} · {badge}) is kept.
grading.note_kept_both: This copy's point score ({score} · {badge}) is kept — switch to Points to see it.
grading.start_intro: Every part starts at 100. Only log what's wrong.
grading.grading_hint: Starts at 100. Only log what's wrong.
grading.confirm_remove_unit: Remove {name} #{n}? Its logged defects will be deleted.
grading.confirm_clear: Clear all logged defects on this copy? Every part goes back to 100.
grading.confirm_profile: The new profile has no place for: {parts}. Their logged defects will be dropped. Continue?
ga.err_lowest: The lowest label must start at 0.
ga.err_same: Two labels start at the same score.
ga.short_code_title: Short code for dashboard counts (e.g. NM)
ga.moves_intro: Some removed labels are still used by simple-graded copies. Choose where those copies go:
ga.labels_desc: Used by both methods: Simple shows them in the Quality dropdown; a point score gets the highest label whose start score it reaches. Changing a start score re-labels scored copies straight away. Renaming keeps every copy on its label.
ga.abbr_title: Short name in the collection table (e.g. Cart)
ga.start_qty_title: Quantity when a copy starts point grading (0 = usually missing)
ga.qty_desc: Users set a quantity per part on each copy (0 = missing, skipped and not penalised; 2+ = each unit graded separately, sharing the part's weight). They can also add their own items, graded with any template.
ga.unassigned: Systems without a default profile: {systems} — users pick a profile per copy there.
ga.all_assigned: Every system has a default profile.
ga.confirm_discard_profile: Discard unsaved changes to this profile?
ga.confirm_remove_part: “{name}” is graded on {n} copies. Removing it deletes that grading when you save. Continue?
ga.confirm_delete_profile: Delete the profile “{name}”? Systems using it will have no default profile.
ga.not_used: Not used by any profile yet.
ga.kinds_desc: each = deduction × count · once = at most once · max N = counter capped at N · level = pick one per group (defects with the same group in a category are mutually exclusive, e.g. Fading: Minor / Moderate / Heavy).
ga.recalc_title: Refreshes every copy's cached score. Saving already does this.
ga.confirm_discard_template: Discard unsaved changes to this template?
ga.confirm_remove_category: Remove this category and its defects?
ga.io_desc: The whole grading system in one JSON file: grade labels, component templates, format profiles, which systems use which profile, and the own-item weight. Users' per-copy grades are not in it — those travel with each user's own collection export (Settings → Backup & Restore).
ga.mode_merge: Merge by name — update what matches, add what's new. Users' grading data is kept.
ga.mode_delmissing: Also remove labels, templates, profiles, parts and defects that are not in the file (users' data on them is deleted)
ga.mode_replace: Replace everything — delete the current system and load the file. All users' point grades are deleted (simple labels are kept and matched by name).
ga.err_json: That file is not valid JSON.
ga.err_format: That is not a grading system export.
ga.prompt_replace: Replace deletes the point grades of {n} copies. Type REPLACE to continue.
ga.confirm_reset:
Reset to the built-in defaults (assets/grading-defaults.json)?

This replaces all labels, templates and profiles.
Systems are re-assigned to profiles by name.
ga.confirm_reset_graded:
Reset to the built-in defaults (assets/grading-defaults.json)?

This replaces all labels, templates and profiles and deletes the point grades of {n} copies (simple labels are kept).
Systems are re-assigned to profiles by name.
gapi.needs_move: Some removed labels are still used by simple-graded copies. Choose where those copies go.
gapi.template_dup: There is already a template called “{name}”.
gapi.defect_name: A defect in “{category}” has no name.
gapi.confirm_defects_lost: Removed defects/categories are logged {n} times on users' copies. Those entries will be deleted and the scores go up. Save anyway?
gapi.template_in_use: This template is used by: {profiles}. Change those parts first.
gapi.confirm_own_items: Users graded their own items with this template on {n} copies. Those items will be deleted. Delete anyway?
gapi.profile_dup: There is already a profile called “{name}”.
gapi.lost_parts: removed parts are graded on {n} copies (that grading is deleted)
gapi.lost_defects: parts with a different template lose {n} logged defects
gapi.confirm_profile_graded: {n} copies are point-graded with this profile. Their point grades are deleted (simple labels stay). Delete anyway?
gapi.none_assigned: No unassigned system matched a known name.
gapi.preview_ready: Preview ready — nothing has been changed yet.
gapi.v_no_labels: The file has no grade labels.
gapi.v_overlap: After this import the grade labels would overlap or not start at 0. Tick “remove items that are not in the file”, or fix the labels first.
gapi.w_system: System “{name}” not found on this site.
gapi.s_moved: ({n} copies moved to the label below it)
api.no_zip: The PHP zip extension is not installed on this server
api.no_photos: No photos found for this system
api.backup_busy: A backup for this system is already being generated
admin.site.new_users_note: What new users start with: one option per line. Existing users keep their own lists. Empty a list to use the default list of the site language again. The price tier is the default for every new copy.
install.title: Setup
install.welcome.lead: This wizard sets up your game collection site: the database, the site settings, the systems you collect and your admin account. It takes a few minutes.
install.welcome.nothing_written: Nothing is written until the last step.
install.req.exif_note: turns phone photos the right way up
install.req.w_config_note: to write config.php; if not, you'll get the file to save yourself
install.req.w_lang_note: needed to upload language files later
install.req.err: Some required items are missing. Fix them on the server and reload this page.
install.db.lead: MySQL 8+ or MariaDB 10.5+. Use an empty database, or let the installer create one.
install.db.name: Database name
install.db.create: Create the database if it doesn't exist (the user needs permission to create databases)
install.db.note: The character set is always utf8mb4. The password ends up in config.php on the server.
install.db.ok_exists: Connected ({version}). Database “{name}” exists and is empty.
install.db.err_host: The host name is not valid.
install.db.err_name: The database name may only contain letters, digits, _ - and $ (max 64).
install.db.err_version: Database server {version} is too old: MySQL 8.0+ or MariaDB 10.5+ is needed.
install.db.err_missing: Database “{name}” doesn't exist. Create it first, or tick “Create the database”.
install.db.err_tables: The database already has tables of this app ({tables}). Use an empty database: the installer never overwrites data.
install.site.lead: How the site is reached, and how uploaded photos are handled.
install.site.base_url_hint: Detected from this page. No trailing slash.
install.site.https: Force HTTPS (redirect http:// to https://; only with an SSL certificate)
install.site.session_hint: Random and unique for this site. Letters, digits and _ only.
install.site.photos_hint: Photos are resized to fit the maximum size and saved as JPEG. The PHP limits upload_max_filesize and post_max_size must allow the upload size too.
install.site.err_url: The base URL must start with http:// or https://.
install.site.err_https: Force HTTPS needs a base URL that starts with https://.
install.site.err_session: The session cookie name must start with a letter and be 3–40 letters, digits or _.
install.site.err_mb: The upload size must be 1–64 MB.
install.site.err_size: The maximum photo size must be 200–4000 px.
install.region.lead: The region of the games you collect, and how prices and dates are shown.
install.region.mixed: Several regions; set it per system later
install.region.currency_note: Prices are stored exactly as imported and never converted: convert price CSVs to this currency before importing them.
install.sys.lead: Pick the systems you collect. You can add, rename or hide systems later on the admin page.
install.sys.note: They are created with region {region}. Game lists are added afterwards (import a list or a price CSV).
install.def.lead: What every new account starts with. Users can change their own lists and grading method in Settings.
install.def.theme_hint: The site default; every user can pick their own theme later.
install.def.err_lists: Both option lists need at least one line.
install.admin.lead: The first account. It can manage users, systems, games, prices and all site settings.
install.admin.keep_pw: Leave empty to keep the password you already entered.
install.admin.rule_user: Not the same as the username
install.admin.err_same: The password can't be the username.
install.admin.invites: Create 3 invite codes now (registration is invite-only)
install.review.lead: Check everything, then install. Use Edit to change a section.
install.review.steps: Install creates the tables, saves the settings, adds the systems and the admin account, then writes config.php and locks the installer.
install.review.failed: Installing failed: {error} Nothing was kept, so you can fix it and try again.
install.log.config_failed: config.php could not be written (see below)
install.done.title: Installed
install.done.config_text: The web server may not write to the site folder, so save this file as config.php in the site folder yourself (next to index.php). The site works as soon as it's there.
install.done.invites: Give these to the people you want to invite. You can make more on the admin page.
install.done.lock_text: install.php refuses to run again while config.php or installed.lock exists. You can also delete install.php from the server now.
install.locked.title: Already installed
install.locked.text: This site is already set up: config.php or installed.lock exists, so the installer is locked. To install again on an empty database, remove both files first. To update an existing site, run the new files in migrations/ instead.
install.sys.no_file: assets/systems.json is missing or not valid JSON, so there are no systems to pick. You can continue and add systems on the admin page later.
ed.sug_intro: Games whose names match once the [bracket] part is removed. Nothing is linked until you accept; rejected groups are not suggested again.
ed.sug_none: No suggestions. Every matching game is linked or rejected.
ed.why_similar: Same name apart from capitals, spaces and punctuation
ed.why_partial: One name contains the other. Check carefully.
ed.ignored_result: Not linked · won't be suggested again
ed.disable_title: Not an edition but the same game (e.g. spelled differently): switch this game off
ed.confirm_disable: Switch off “{title}”? It's hidden from collections, wishlists and suggestions. You can enable it again under Game lists.
ed.confirm_disable_copies: “{title}” is in users' collections or wishlists ({n}×). Switching it off hides those too. Switch it off anyway? You can enable it again under Game lists.
ed.confirm_unlink: Unlink the editions of {title}? Users' copies stay on the edition they were added to.
ed.hint_one_group: Pick games from one linked group at most.
ed.hint_more: Tick at least one more game.
ed.dlg_note: Each edition keeps its own prices and price link. Users' copies stay on the edition they were added to.
ed.err_system: All games must be in the same system.
ed.err_linked: {title} is already linked to another group.
ed.err_main: The main release must be one of the linked games.
ed.mode_one_desc: Owning any edition completes the game. Editions are folded under the game in your collection.
ed.mode_one_eg: You own Gran Turismo [Platinum] → Gran Turismo counts as owned.

updates.step1: Make a full backup under Settings › Site Backup and download it.
updates.step2: Download the zip and extract it. It holds one folder: the files inside it are the site's files.
updates.step3: Upload those files over the site's files. config.php isn't in the zip and uploads/ only holds folder settings, so your settings and photos stay. If you changed web.config or .htaccess, don't overwrite them.
updates.step4: Open the site. If the update changes the database, admins are sent to this page to run it; other users see a short notice until then.

sbackup.keep_hint: Counted per kind (scheduled / before an update); older ones are deleted. Backups you make yourself stay until you delete them.
sbackup.update_note: Settings › Updates also saves a database backup before each database update (you can untick it there).
sbackup.restore_desc: Restoring is done by hand, so nothing on the site can be overwritten by accident. The same steps are in README.txt inside every backup.
sbackup.restore1: Download the backup and extract it. backup.json says which version of the site made it and what's inside.
sbackup.restore2: On a new server: install the same version of the site first (see Settings › Updates for the releases). On this site: skip this step.
sbackup.restore3: Database: import database.sql with phpMyAdmin (Import) or the mysql client. It replaces every table it contains, so import it into the site's own (or an empty) database.
sbackup.restore4: Files: upload the uploads/ folder over the site's uploads/ folder. site-files/ holds the language files and themes as they were: copy back only the ones you added or changed yourself (to lang/ and assets/themes/).
sbackup.restore5: Sign in. If the backup came from an older version, admins are sent to Settings › Updates to run the database updates.
sbackup.readme:
{site} - site backup
Made {date} by version {version}
Contents: {parts}

RESTORING
1. On a new server, install version {version} of the site first. On the same site, skip this step.
2. Database: import database.sql with phpMyAdmin (Import) or: mysql -u USER -p DATABASE < database.sql
   It replaces every table it contains.
3. Files: upload the uploads/ folder over the site's uploads/ folder.
   site-files/lang/ and site-files/themes/ hold every language file and theme as they were:
   copy back only the ones you added or changed yourself (to lang/ and assets/themes/).
4. Sign in. If the site is newer than this backup, admins are sent to Settings > Updates
   to run the database updates.

config.php (database password) is never part of a backup.

igdb.intro: Developer, publisher, genres, release date and ratings from IGDB, shown to everyone in the game drawer. Games are matched by title on the system's IGDB platform; a game you add is looked up straight away; imported games wait for Match (a notice shows how many).
igdb.setup_intro: IGDB is free for non-commercial use. It needs a Twitch app of your own:
igdb.setup_1: Sign in at dev.twitch.tv/console with a Twitch account that has two-factor authentication turned on.
igdb.setup_2: Applications › Register Your Application: any name, OAuth Redirect URL http://localhost, Client Type Confidential.
igdb.setup_3: Manage the app: copy the Client ID, press New Secret and copy the Client Secret (it is shown only once).
igdb.setup_4: Add both to config.php on this server, then reload this page:
igdb.setup_terms: The secret stays in config.php, so it is not part of site backups. Use of IGDB falls under the Twitch Developer Services Agreement.
igdb.systems_help: Set each system's IGDB platform, then Match looks up the games that were never looked up. Refresh fetches the info of matched games again (ratings change over time).
igdb.skip_on_help: Never look this system's games up on IGDB, e.g. hardware (consoles, controllers, peripherals). Its games aren't counted as waiting.
igdb.skip_off_help: Look this system up on IGDB again: Match works on it, and new games count as waiting.
igdb.why_skipped: This system is set to Don't match
igdb.dash_notice_one: ★ 1 game is waiting to be matched on IGDB. Open Settings › IGDB and use Match.
igdb.dash_notice_other: ★ {n} games are waiting to be matched on IGDB. Open Settings › IGDB and use Match.
igdb.pending_notice_one: ★ 1 game hasn't been looked up on IGDB yet (imports leave new games for you). Use Match on its system below.
igdb.pending_notice_other: ★ {n} games haven't been looked up on IGDB yet (imports leave new games for you). Use Match on their systems below.
igdb.match_all_help: Runs Match on every system that still has games not looked up, one after another. Systems set to Don't match are left out.
igdb.refresh_all_help: Runs Refresh on every system with matched games, one after another. Systems set to Don't match are left out.
igdb.why_all_none_match: No system has games waiting to be looked up
igdb.why_all_none_refresh: No system has matched games yet
igdb.covers_intro: Which cover every game shows: the uploaded cover or IGDB's (the system's regional box when IGDB has one). When a game lacks the chosen one, the other is shown. A single game can show the other cover: pick it in Settings › Catalogue (game list) or with the cover switch in the game drawer.
igdb.covers_not_connected: Covers from IGDB can be used once IGDB is connected.
igdb.covers_help: IGDB covers come with Match and Refresh: run Refresh on systems matched before covers existed. They are shown from images.igdb.com, nothing is downloaded.
igdb.covers_overrides_one: {n} game has its own cover choice.
igdb.covers_overrides_other: {n} games have their own cover choice.
igdb.covers_clear: Set all back to the site default
igdb.covers_clear_confirm: Every game follows the site default again. Continue?
igdb.covers_cleared_other: {n} games follow the site default again.
igdb.covers_cleared_one: {n} game follows the site default again.
igdb.why_none_pending: Every game has been looked up
igdb.redo_confirm: Look up the {n} games to review again? Games an admin linked or marked stay as they are.
igdb.match_stopped: {system}: matching stopped — Match continues where it left off
igdb.match_starting: Looking up {n} games — the page updates every few seconds. Keep this page open until it's done.
igdb.help_review: The automatic match wasn't sure. Pick the right game, search for it, or mark it as not on IGDB.
igdb.help_matched: Linked to an IGDB game. Automatic: matched by title · Confirmed: picked by an admin.
igdb.help_none: Marked as not on IGDB: nothing is shown in the drawer. An edition in the same group can still lend its info.
igdb.help_pending: Never looked up. Match in the Systems table looks them all up.
igdb.empty_none: No games are marked as not on IGDB.
igdb.empty_pending: Every game has been looked up.
igdb.no_candidates: No games with this name on this platform.
igdb.platform_change_note: Changing the platform looks up the automatic matches and open reviews of this system again. Games an admin linked or marked stay as they are.
igdb.platform_confirm: Automatic matches and open reviews of this system will be looked up again. Continue?
igdb.pick_ph: Name, igdb.com link or IGDB id
igdb.pick_hint: Searches titles, alternative titles and regional titles. Or paste the game's igdb.com link, or its IGDB id, to link that exact game.
igdb.no_tables: The IGDB table doesn't exist yet: run the database updates in Settings › Updates.
igdb.err_no_tables: The IGDB table doesn't exist yet: run the database updates in Settings › Updates.
igdb.err_forbidden: Only admins can change IGDB settings.
igdb.err_not_configured: IGDB isn't connected: add IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET to config.php.
igdb.err_no_platform: Set the system's IGDB platform first.
igdb.err_not_found: That game wasn't found on IGDB.
igdb.err_token: Twitch didn't accept the IGDB credentials (HTTP {code}). Check IGDB_CLIENT_ID and IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET in config.php.
igdb.err_api: IGDB answered with an error (HTTP {code}). Try again in a moment.
igdb.err_curl: PHP's curl extension is needed to reach IGDB.
igdb.drawer_empty: IGDB has no details for this game yet.
igdb.col_from_contents: Combined from the games inside this compilation
igdb.other_region_title: IGDB has no date for this system's region: this is the first release elsewhere
